hard_rules: E6-A remains the sole owner of provider descriptor state query and Candidate normalization semantics
provider configuration is exact and runtime discovery cannot widen it
public requests contain only nonsecret credential references and authorization receipts
service never installs starts configures indexes imports deletes or mutates a provider
provider sessions expose only the E6-A allowlisted transport
operation identity is durable before provider dispatch and OutcomeUnknown blocks blind repeat
results artifacts mappings selections and context publications are separate immutable effects
external results remain semantic_candidate plus Candidate with no negative authority
project and reference owners alone map UnverifiedProviderLocator into exact owner records
NoMappingWithOwnerAuthority requires complete exact owner coverage
mapping validates locator identity only and never provider semantics
candidate selection is explicit and never inferred from rank score order name path count or popularity
selection is not verification acceptance edit authorization lineage replacement or core promotion
context handoff requires ExactMapped plus Selected and one exact mapped root
provider metadata remains a separate Candidate sidecar and never enters ContextSemanticPack truth
provider failure is lane local and never degrades exact local capabilities
no hidden fallback to another provider stale cache model web local search or broader query
credentials private endpoints provider cursors databases source and owner handles are redacted and bounded
no public success before retention audit and reverse resource closure
applications depend on wow-service only and invoke one service operation per command
missing implementation adapter probe mapping context benchmark runtime or checksum evidence is blocked or NotEvaluated never pass
no Cargo Rust source public transport distribution or CI during documentation phase

required_before_first_rust_implementatio: all E0 through E6-A prerequisite implementation commits and fixture bundle digests
provider configuration credential authorization session transport result store mapping context retention and audit port identities
reviewed provider session credential quota cancellation reconciliation privacy license and close profiles without committed secrets
exact project reference graph acquisition and locator mapping profiles with negative-authority rules
selection context sidecar result envelope CLI output and canonicalization profiles
synthetic and admitted real stable mutable opaque partial zero ambiguous conflict response-loss cancellation and context fixtures
measured byte item depth time memory quota owner-call context and output limits
all canonical request result artifact mapping selection context reconciliation error and CLI vectors
all member and bundle SHA-256 values
